testInfo.description: oauth2as example OP, OIDC basic certification profile
testInfo.summary: This test obtains refresh tokens and performs various checks, including checking that the refresh token works and is correctly bound to the client. Support for refresh tokens is optional and the test will be skipped if the token endpoint response does not return refresh tokens. scope=offline_access will be included in the authorization endpoint request if the server's discovery document indicates support for this scope.
